req.title: Set cookie via query string
req.statement: The system shall set cookies for every k=v pair supplied in the query string of GET /cookies/set.

doc.reasoning: The endpoint GET /cookies/set sets one cookie per k=v query parameter and redirects to /cookies. Tests must verify: (1) positive - single k=v pair sets the cookie correctly with exact name/value; (2) positive multi - multiple k=v pairs all set; (3) negative - no query params yields redirect with empty cookies; (4) boundary - empty string value for a key; (5) state transition - redirect chain lands on /cookies with correct payload. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (302 not just 3xx), exact cookie names and values, exact redirect Location header, and exact JSON payload from /cookies after following the redirect.

tests.name: test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No pre-existing cookies in the test client
actions: Assert 200 and cookies JSON contains foo=bar exactly
trace: R-HTTPBIN-031: system shall set cookies for every k=v pair in query string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?foo=bar', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/cookies'
    r2 = client.get('/cookies/set?foo=bar', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    data = r2.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies'] == {'foo': 'bar'}

test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string()

from httpbin.core import app

def test_set_multiple_cookies_via_query_string():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?alpha=1&beta=2&gamma=three', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['alpha'] == '1'
    assert data['cookies']['beta'] == '2'
    assert data['cookies']['gamma'] == 'three'
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 3

def test_set_cookie_redirect_location_exact():

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-031: each k maps to its own v, not another pair's value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_set_cookie_value_not_overwritten_by_wrong_key():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?key1=val1&key2=val2', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert data['cookies']['key1'] == 'val1'
    assert data['cookies']['key2'] == 'val2'
    assert data['cookies']['key1'] != 'val2'
    assert data['cookies']['key2'] != 'val1'
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 2

test_set_cookie_value_not_overwritten_by_wrong_key()
